title: Design: With no internal customer the first hint says none is flagged yet
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have no customer flagged as Internal customer.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow0-09-03-settings-setting-on-no-flagged-customer.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first hint line under the Internal Work Orders description reads "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now."
  • Nothing on the page is disabled or marked as required because of it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R4: “While the toggle is on and no customer carries the flag, the first hint of S1-R3 reads instead "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now." The text is informational; nothing is required and nothing is blocked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
